$comment: Pillar → supporting map. One pillar page per cluster; supporting posts link up to the pillar and across to siblings.

clusters.description: Deal context that happens where no meeting bot can follow.
Who your sales AI actually works for — rep or manager.
Champions going quiet, buyers never engaged, context lost between calls.
Founders Club, onboarding, what early access actually means.
AI for in-person, field-heavy selling where no screen or recording device is present.
The rep-side cost of call recording and scoring — anxiety, legal exposure, scorecard distortion, and the private alternative.
Med device, pharma, financial services, healthcare IT — why not recording is the actual requirement, not a preference.
Specific AE personas — ADHD, introverts, new hires, reps who hate cold calling — where generic sales AI misses persona-specific friction.
Founders selling solo and the transition to a first sales hire — the judgment that has to transfer, not just the process.
Personal knowledge management and second-brain systems, rebuilt for the pace and rhythm of a sales rep's day.
Deal-relevant conversations that happen off the calendar — hallway asides, parking lot debriefs, the minutes before and after a scheduled meeting.
Reps bringing their own AI tools to work instead of the sanctioned surveillance stack — the thinking-partner category the official tools were never built to serve.
Structured after-the-fact review of a deal that closed lost — separating the reason a rep logs from what actually happened.
